Dear colleague,
Your indicative funding allocation for academic year @year1 to @year2
Please find below your indicative funding allocation statement for general annual grant (GAG) funding for the @year1 to @year2 academic year.

We'll confirm your allocation towards the end of the month in which you open. Please note that changes between an indicative and confirmed funding allocation happen rarely and in exceptional circumstances only.
If your academy has a sixth form, your post 16 funding will be set out in a separate 16 to 19 statement.
Your funding will be paid in equal instalments on the first working day of each month, except in the first month of opening where payment will be made on the 6th working day of the month.
What you need to do next
<ul style='line-height:160%;'>
• return your completed academy bank details form no later than the 20th of the month prior to your intended opening date, if you haven't already done so
• check the account has been activated by your bank
• set up your own business systems
• create your document exchange account
• make sure your contact details on Get Information about Schools are accurate and complete
• register for ESFA Update alerts
Understanding your indicative allocation statement
There is a range of information available to help you understand your allocation statement:
<ul style='list-style-type:square;line-height:160%;'>
• Academies general annual grant allocation guide
• Academies planning calendar
• Guidance pack for new academies
Contact us
We hope this material provides all the information you need but please contact us via the ESFA help centre
if you have any further questions about your allocation.
I would like to take this opportunity to wish you every success for the future.
Yours faithfully,
Andy Humphreys
Data and Quality Assurance Unit – Schools Funding Data Team Leader,
Funding Directorate
